maria: heads up — perf unit failed on PR #20211 during mergegate.
ci-bot: perf-diff: +8.7% median latency on microbench batcher_kv_warmup (threshold 3%)
chris: Ugh. Repro locally? Any stacktraces from flamegraphs?
alex: I pulled the jar, flamegraph shows a bigger spin in kernel_selector::select_path around 80-120ms. KV hits unchanged. Pasting top lines:
```
kernel_selector::select_path 79.4ms
batch_scheduler::coalesce_wait 12.1ms
kv_cache::get_prefix 3.2ms
```
maria: interesting — CI suggests warmup path changed, maybe a prefetch ordering regression from the merge.
sam: bisecting now between merge commit a1b2c3 and prior. preliminary points to commit a1b2c3 -> introduced scheduler reorder.
chris: can we gate the PR? This blocks the rollout. maria can you add a temporary perf revert or pin older scheduler heuristic?
maria: pushed revert branch to unbreak mergegate, link: https://git.redwood/merge/a1b2c3-revert :thumbsup:
ci-bot: started new job for revert PR #20212 — will update when goldens run finish.
alex: also logging: attaching small repro script snippet to run microbench locally:
```
./tools/run_microbench --bench batcher_kv_warmup --iters 1000 --seed 42
```
sam: will follow up with flamegraphs and bisect notes in the PR. if anyone hits a faster repro ping me.
chris: thanks all. once CI green we can un-block the mergegate.
